_comment: The registry of benchmarkable engines — the single source of truth.
An engine is one registry process under test: an implementation, a storage
backend, a port, and a data directory. bench.sh reads this with jq and the
ansible playbook reads it with from_json, so a new engine is added here and
kind              implementation that serves it; picks the ansible role
storage           where blobs land: fs (local NVMe) | azure | s3
port              listen port, distinct per engine so a stray process is
option            engine-specific knob. For summ this is the metadata engine
(summ serve --engine). Empty for distribution, whose backend
is chosen by the rendered config file instead.
requires_provider cloud provider the engine needs, if any. Naming one that
does not match --provider is an error, not a silent skip:
a summary missing a row is a result nobody questions.
